## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tested against the live ECFS API (`npm run test:live`) if API calls changed
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Rebuilt `dist/` (`npm run build`) if `src/` changed. The plugin ships `dist/`.
- [ ] Updated the README and slash commands if tools or behavior changed
- [ ] No API keys, `.env` contents, or other secrets in the code, tests, or logs
